entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Uprising of Konstantin and Fruzhin was the earliest Bulgarian uprising against Ottoman rule. It was organized in the early 15th century by two Bulgarian nobles, Fruzhin and his cousin Konstantin, and was supported by a Christian coalition, but failed to liberate Bulgaria.
